title: Unsettled Spirits (Part 1)
flavor: Io is everywhere, and in all things. Denounced by enemies as the great unmaker, worshiped by scholars as the twinkling of a divine eye, this strange Wisp of life-force occupies all planes at once, the merest fraction of its being crossing into physical existence at any one moment. Its motives inscrutable, its strength unimaginable, Io moves through the physical plane, the perfect expression of the mysteries of the universe.

entries.name: IO - Tether
entries.detail: Reworked. <Battlecry Ability: Activates before the battle starts> IO tethers with allies around, granting percentage damage reduction. Health percentage will be distributed equally among all tethered allies at set intervals. P.S. Tether will break when IO dies or is too far from its ally. P.S. Health from redistribution of tether will not be counted as Heal. The benevolent touch of Io brings strength from between the planes.

entries.name: Kobold - Divided We Stand
entries.detail: (2) Reworked. (1) Kobold: If every friendly Kobold piece on board can be paired with another identical same-rank Kobold, summons a replica for each pair when battle starts. (2) Kobolds: Every unpaired Kobold piece will reshape itself into a non-Kobold ally of the same Rank before battle starts. P.S. Paired Kobolds will keep themselves. P.S. Unpaired Kobolds will reshape into highest level allies of the same rank.
